focus.name: player-followup-response-family
focus.purpose: Promote compact player and actor collision follow-up entries whose exact state, transition, and response behavior is established by static decompilation.

type02: arms PLAYER_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER=4 and PLAYER_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_PHASE=0xFF within the vertical contact window
nudges the actor X coordinate toward PLAYER_WORLD_X and enters Player_SuppressCollisionResponse
otherwise raises PLAYER_COLLISION_RESPONSE_SUPPRESS during an active terrain response or places PLAYER_Y from actor Y and WORLD_CAMERA_Y
contracts.type0c: when PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is nonzero, clears the actor and owned resources and reinitializes the response slot
contracts.type46: increments GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER below ASCII '9' and reinitializes the collision template
contracts.type54: queues event 0x65 when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is active and sets PLAYER_TERMINAL_TRANSITION=0xFF
contracts.type1b_1c: clear their respective terrain-map pair and publish their interaction latch when the actor phase byte is clear, then enter the shared terminal-response continuation
